entry.title: Airwindows Collection: Effects 0.1.0
entry.summary: # Airwindows for MPC and Force 0.1.0 The first eleven collections of Chris Johnson's Airwindows effects as native MPC OS plugins. One plugin per Airwindows category; each holds every effect in that category, with its own panel, Q-Link badges and a MANUAL tab. See the README for the approach. | Plugin | Models | |---|---| | AW Tape | 12 | | AW Distortion | 15 | | AW Saturation | 20 | | AW Dynamics | 35 | | AW Filter | 54 | | AW Reverb | 42 | | AW Ambience (includes Echojam) | 26 | | AW Consoles |
